blocks.html: For all purposes of this Chapter, the Special Brooklyn Navy Yard District shall be deemed to be a single zoning lot except where expressly provided otherwise in this Chapter. Floor area attributable to the zoning lot may be located anywhere on the zoning lot without regard to Subdistrict boundary lines, and all floor area located within a Subdistrict shall be subject to the use and bulk requirements of such Subdistrict.
blocks.plainText: For all purposes of this Chapter, the Special Brooklyn Navy Yard District shall be deemed to be a single zoning lot except where expressly provided otherwise in this Chapter. Floor area attributable to the zoning lot may be located anywhere on the zoning lot without regard to Subdistrict boundary lines, and all floor area located within a Subdistrict shall be subject to the use and bulk requirements of such Subdistrict.
